product.name: Order Manager
product.description: Ecommerce Helper — the back office for orders from any checkout, ours or another one: a status matrix as data (transitions with checks and side effects, customer cancellation, auto-expiry), carriers and tracking links, serial capture with validation, invoices and receipts, packing slips and pick lists, bulk changes and CSV, risk controls (open-order caps, blocklist, return-to-origin flags, the pay-on-delivery confirmation step), customer status messages through the merchant's own messaging connector, a real payments and refunds ledger and an inbound API with schema mapping. Publishes the catalogued order events; all data, personal data included, lives in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Lifecycle
elements.description: Orders and their status matrix as data: statuses with revenue / open / cancellable flags and auto-expiry, transitions with who may move them, checks (serials, tracking, full refund, return reason) and the catalogued order event they publish; a timeline per order; customers read their own orders and cancel while allowed (pk_ key + verified SS-Identity).

elements.name: Fulfilment
elements.description: Your carriers with tracking URL templates and service levels, tracking numbers and links per order, dispatch video links, and a tracking lookup by order number and contact for guests.

elements.name: Serials
elements.description: A serial per unit, validated by rules kept as data (character set, length, Luhn check digit), unique per order or website, required before dispatch for flagged lines; lookup by serial.

elements.name: Invoices & receipts
elements.description: Customer and internal invoices and receipts as printable HTML rendered on the server from the order snapshot (warranty and tax lines per line as placed, serials, payments and balance due) with your business details and legal text; gap-free invoice numbers; metered per render.

elements.name: Packing slips & pick lists
elements.description: Printable packing slips (recipient, lines, a serial slot per unit, the amount to collect on delivery) and pick lists aggregated by SKU across the selected orders.

elements.name: Bulk & CSV
elements.description: Bulk status changes validated per order exactly like single changes, CSV export with chosen columns, and CSV import of status and tracking updates with a dry run.

elements.name: Risk
elements.description: Open-order caps per customer, a blocklist (customer id, e-mail, phone), return-to-origin counters with a warning threshold, pay-on-delivery caps and advances, the pay-on-delivery confirmation step, a manual review queue and a pre-checkout risk check.

elements.name: Customer updates
elements.description: Status messages to customers through your own messaging connector, with templates per status, language and channel; claim-before-send, retries and a message log. Can hand messages to a messaging product instead (orders.customer_update@1).

elements.name: Payments ledger
elements.description: Every payment and refund as an append-only entry (amount, method, reference, proof, who and when); refunds can never exceed what was received; partial refunds; balance due; reconciliation across orders; publishes order.paid@1 and order.refunded@1.

elements.name: Inbound orders
elements.description: Receive orders from any external checkout with the website's sk_ key (our order schema or your own through a schema mapping), idempotent per external id, and from order.placed@1 events of the Checkout product; metered per order received.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Lifecycle, fulfilment, serials, invoices, packing slips, the payments ledger, customer updates and inbound orders; bulk tools and risk controls as add-ons.
